versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00176, SRS_Rte_00177 The RTE Generator shall reject configurations where the EcucPartition which ref- erences an NvBlockSwComponentType (via ECUC parameter EcucPartition- SoftwareComponentInstanceRef ) does not match the EcucPartition refer- enced by all NvMBlockDescriptor s (via the ECUC parameter NvMBlockEcucPar- titionRef ) associated with that NvBlockSwComponentType .
